## 73672e29b8e0

**Reproduced distribution mismatch.** All four canonical inputs are 10×10, with 17–32 nonzero cells and 6–9 nonzero colors. In 1,200 default draws (400 per difficulty band), the generator emitted zero 10×10 scenes, only 7–17 nonzero cells, and only 4–5 nonzero colors. Exact `grid_h=10, grid_w=10` overrides are impossible in every band: easy rejects height 10 outside `[4,6]`, medium rejects it outside `[5,9]`, and hard rejects width 10 outside `[13,16]`. This is concrete missing canonical support, not merely a stylistic difference. Evidence: `checks/audits/73672e29b8e0_probe.json`.

**Reproduced dead axis.** For seed 123, sample index 7, medium difficulty, `anchor_corner=False` and `anchor_corner=True` returned byte-identical 5×13 grids. Thus a declared control is not causally observable for that same-seed witness. Evidence: `checks/audits/73672e29b8e0_probe.json`.

**Lint result.** The standalone lint did not proceed past the missing required `RULE_HASH` constant (`checks/audit_736_lint/checks/73672e29b8e0_after_lint.log`). I did not modify the audited generator.

triage.reason: Read and retained with later revision; original notes, audits and solve records preserved.

audits.text:
## 73672e29b8e0

**Reproduced distribution and dead-control defects; no fix included.** Source reviewed: SHA-256 `af57c02b2e5bf659907996bd0d5363d7d2f0cedc6533c69b54aa0d78831c3ff5`. Executed rule hash: `626f141e35dd`.

All four labeled canonical inputs are 10×10, contain 17–32 nonzero cells, and use 6–9 nonzero colors. In 300 default draws—100 per band, seed base `73672000`, sample indices 0–99—generation produced 300 unique inputs but **zero** 10×10 grids; generated inputs had 7–16 nonzero cells and only 4–5 nonzero colors. The difficulty ranges make exact 10×10 impossible: easy/medium cannot reach height 10, while hard widths start at 13.

The advertised boolean `anchor_corner` control is also dead. With seed `73672999`, sample index 17, difficulty `medium`, `anchor_corner=false` and `anchor_corner=true` produce byte-identical valid inputs and identical Racket outputs. Both inputs pass `self_check`. The axis has no implementation use beyond being accepted.

Evidence and exact commands:

- `checks/audit/73672e29b8e0/probe.json`
- `checks/audit/73672e29b8e0/input.json`
- `checks/audit/73672e29b8e0/racket.json`
- `checks/audit/probe_audits.py`

The generated control witness belongs to the documented ordinary generator domain. The distribution comparison is measured support drift, not a claim that the Racket labels are wrong.

triage.reason: Accepted as source-bound reviewer-reported findings. 73672e29b8e0: generated support misses canonical dimensions/density/palette and anchor_corner is ineffective. 6d678fbbe87e: component-bbox rival survives canonical/default samples; counterexample is validator-accepted but outside the documented ordinary separated-three-cell-block sampler. Preserve this support distinction; no audited source changed.
